semiconductor_relevance: High — DYNEX specializes in engineering plastics that are critical for semiconductor fabrication processes, particularly in CMP applications.
summary: DYNEX is a leading manufacturer of semi-finished engineering plastic products, supplying high-performance materials such as PEEK and PPS for semiconductor applications. Their products are designed for use in CMP retainer rings, offering exceptional wear resistance and chemical stability essential for semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: High-precision PPS and PEEK tubing for CMP rings
Engineering plastics with excellent mechanical and chemical properties
